title: Dangme language - Wikipedia
text: Adangme is a Kwa language, part of the Niger–Congo family. It is closely related to Ga, and together they form the Ga–Dangme branch within Kwa. [3] Adangme is spoken in Ghana by over 800,000 people as of 2004. [4]
